verdict.rationale: Paddle is a hosted billing and merchant-of-record platform. Self-hosting is a fair axis for billing products, but nothing in the evidence shows Paddle can be deployed on your own infrastructure. Every documented surface (API, checkout, the hosted remote MCP server, sandbox) runs on Paddle's own servers, and the published OpenAPI spec and SDKs are client-side building blocks, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
